findings: adds an optional Rust crate (no dependencies; CI runs cargo --locked --offline) that tools/glb_writer.py loads by default with ctypes.PyDLL from tools/glb_native/target/release (LEONIDA_GLB_NATIVE=0 turns it off); no network, file or process code in the crate
